title: Sorry not to sure what I am doing.
author: ShadowBreakGames
selftext:
I posted this earlier but didn't put a link to the game or even explain what I was trying to do, sorry for the repost.

I have been using AI to make an old school hack and slash game inspired by games like golden axe, I decided to go for a paper cut look, I used Claude to help me make a program that would allow me to instantly arrange and rig and characters created all ready to make animations with key frames, if someone could have a look and give a little bit of feedback that would be much appreciated.

Thank you.
